title: Sovereign Gold Bond redeemed by RBI at maturity (Nov-2025, before 1-Apr-2026): exempt under s.47(viic)
rules: Income-tax Act 1961 s.47(viic) (inserted by Finance Act 2016 w.e.f. AY 2017-18): any redemption by an individual of Sovereign Gold Bonds issued by RBI under the Sovereign Gold Bond Scheme, 2015 is not a transfer -> no capital gain
The clause as worded has no original-subscriber condition, so sgb_original_subscriber does not change the answer for redemptions before 1-Apr-2026 (see INDEX.md on the position after 1-Apr-2026)
derivation: Subscription 2017-11-20: 10 units @ 3,000.00 -> cost 30,000.00 (no STT on SGB).
RBI redemption 2025-11-20 (8-year maturity; meta rbi_redemption + held_to_maturity): 10 @ 12,000.00 -> proceeds 1,20,000.00.
s.47(viic): not a transfer -> taxable gain 0.00, term exempt, rate null.
No other capital gains -> exemption_used 0.00 (no s.112A gain), tax 0.00, cess 0.00, total 0.00.
